milestone.name: K8.3 - Context Need Optimization Layer
milestone.summary: Freeze minimum necessary context selection for intended interaction without context dump, starvation, pollution, or false continuity.

review.name: K8.3 Context Need Optimization Contract Freeze

principles: More context does not mean more Julia.
Relevant context creates better Julia behavior.
Context supports behavior, not answer content.
objective: Select the minimum context required to support the intended interaction.
acceptance_targets: Defines Context Requirement Object with required, optional, avoid, context depth, and rationale.
Context Requirement selects minimum necessary context, not maximum available context.
Context Requirement treats context as behavior support, not answer content.
K8.3 can select light relationship/experience context for relationship confirmation without identity dump.
K8.3 can select re-entry/experience/project context for prior ongoing topics without starving continuity.
K8.3 avoids relationship/identity contamination for ordinary technical or market questions.
K8.3 avoids false continuity on unrelated new tasks.
Negative gates detect Context Dump, Context Starvation, Context Pollution, and False Continuity.
K8.3 does not mutate Identity, Relationship, Memory, Experience, Re-entry, or Event artifacts.
K8.3 output remains provider/context input only, not final response.
K8.3 remains separate from K8.4 Natural Expression Boundary.

metrics.CSE: Interaction Relevant Context - Irrelevant Context Activation
metrics.COQS: Minimum Sufficiency + Relevance Accuracy + Starvation Avoidance + Pollution Avoidance + Boundary Compliance - Dump Risk - False Continuity Risk
